title: Should I continue adding more levels or I should build something else
author: Muted_Disaster4187
selftext: I am bit confused if I should continue building the levels or not. RIght now I am building level 14. Though I enjoy playing the game but I am highly doubtful if this will get any downloads. What do you guys think about the game? If anyone wants to try it and give feedback, I can send my App Store link.

replies.author: Muted_Disaster4187
replies.body:
No actually it's name is Arrow Fall but I like the name happy arrow. If you don't mind I would like to rename my app to hoppy arrow.
In case you would like to try the game here's the link.
[Arrow Fall](https://apps.apple.com/app/arrow-fall/id6770287546)

replies.author: Am_Biyori
replies.body: Would happen to have a non-Apple version?

comments.author: CriticalLoreDrop
comments.body: I don't understand why you'd even bother making something so simple with AI? It'd take you the same time or less to just learn to make it yourself. This is like a 30 minute tutorial.

comments.author: Am_Biyori
comments.body: You've got a great starting point here. Try taking the graphics up a notch, and/or add some surprise obsticals and a little juice to the movements.

replies.author: Muted_Disaster4187
replies.body: Thanks mate. It would be great if you can guide me a little bit with how I can improve the graphics up a notch.

replies.author: Muted_Disaster4187
replies.body: Couldn't it be improved further? I mean it's my starting project. I am new to game dev and learning by building stuff with help of ai. Maybe in future I can build something that could be fun to play.
